**Cron #5 — eod-international-daily — 2026-10-28**

- Daily EOD snapshot for the 16 international markets the skill covers (AU, JP, TW, CA and the 12 EU venues), written after each market's cash close settled.
- **4,876 instrument rows across 16 per-region CSVs**, one row per listed instrument, sorted by market cap (USD) descending.

- **Read this first:** `market_cap` is normalised to **USD** (the skill's own filter spec is USD-based), while `close`/`open`/`high`/`low` stay in the **local listing currency** — the `currency` column states which.
- `change_pct` is TradingView's daily change, and on a corporate-action day (reverse split, subscription-receipt conversion, listing debut) that field can reflect the adjustment rather than a real session move.
- Both cases seen today are flagged in *Caveats*.

**Method**

- **Universe** — the skill's `mcp__tradingview-advanced__stock_screener(country=…)` is not registered in the Cloud runtime.
- The same underlying source is reachable over its public per-country scanner API, so each region was pulled with a `country` filter matching the instrument's own country of primary listing.
- Without that filter the per-country endpoint also returns *foreign* stocks quoted on that market's venues (NVIDIA, Apple and even SpaceX on Lang & Schwarz with WKN-style symbols), which would have inflated Germany from ~500 companies to 36,006 rows.
- With the filter, every region lands on its real listed-company count (Athens 128, Madrid 272, Vienna 65, Dublin 19, Helsinki 186, Copenhagen 134, Euronext Paris 545, Borsa Italiana 393, TSE 3,758, TWSE 1,082, ASX 1,558).
- **Venue dedupe** — one row per instrument, preferring the official listing venue (XETR/FWB, TSE, TSX/TSXV, TWSE/TPEX, MIL, BME, VIE, OMXHEX, OMXCOP, ATHEX, EURONEXT, ASX), then the highest-volume row.
- Germany needs one extra rule:
- Lang & Schwarz (LS/LSX) carries the *same* shares under WKN-style symbols (`LSX:716460` = SAP SE) with visibly worse prints, so a company already covered by an official venue drops its off-exchange row.
- Distinct German share classes keep their own description (`METRO AG` vs `METRO AG Pref Bearer Shs`) and survive, as do Canadian preferred lines (`MFC` vs `MFC.PR.K`).
- **Enrichment** —
- `volume`, `pe_ratio` and `sector` come straight from the same scanner response, so the skill's Yahoo `compare_stocks` enrichment stage was **not needed and was skipped** (it is also unreachable here —
- Yahoo's JSON endpoints return HTTP 429 from this egress). Schema coverage: volume non-zero on 4,732/4,876 rows, `pe_ratio` on 3,865, `sector` on 4,875.
- **Movers mode** — the skill's Tue–Thu forward-fill optimisation was **not applied**:
- it needs the previous day's CSV, and this is the first run to write the `international-eod/` path (the repo had no prior artifact).
- Forward-filling would also stamp stale closes with today's date and a `change_pct` of 0.
- A full fresh pull costs 16 HTTP calls here, so every row is a real 2026-10-28 print.
- **Market cap** —
- `market_cap_basic` is in the row's **local** currency, so every value is converted to USD with the 28 Oct open.er-api rate table (EUR 0.897453, AUD 1.422618, CAD 1.404056, JPY 157.892678, DKK 6.706467, TWD 32.438942 per USD).
- Frankfurter agrees on all five currencies it covers to within 0.10% (TWD is not an ECB currency and is single-sourced).

**Caveats**

- **Off-exchange venue rows.** 47 rows across the set (29 Germany, 18 Canada) come from secondary venues —
- Lang & Schwarz / GETTEX for German names that have no Xetra listing, and Cboe Canada / CSE for Canadian names with no TSX/TSXV listing.
- Those prints are thinner and can lag the official close; the `exchange` column identifies them.
- **Corporate actions distort `change_pct`** — reverse splits (ASX:WCN today), subscription-receipt conversions and listing debuts (CSE:FLY) produce changes that are not session moves.
- The `open` column is the cleanest tell: `CSE:FLY` shows open 5.00 against a 0.75 reference price.
- **Regional Japanese venues.** 5 rows come from Nagoya / Sapporo rather than TSE.
- Those venues carry thin volume and have previously shown stale prior closes, so treat their `change_pct` as indicative.
- **Two rows have an empty `change_pct` and `market_cap`** (`ASX:JRL`, `NEO:AIOS`) — the source returned no reference price for them.
- Every other row has a parseable change, and no row has a non-positive close, and no row violates high ≥ max(open, close) / low ≤ min(open, close).
- **Cross-listings are not deduplicated against the US snapshot.** As the skill already notes, a name listed in two markets appears in both files with different closes.

**Source health**

- **Source**: TradingView scanner (per-country) · **Query / URL**: `POST https://scanner.tradingview.com/{australia,japan,taiwan,canada,germany,france,italy,spain,netherlands,belgium,austria,portugal,ireland,finland,denmark,greece}/scan` · **Status**: `ok` · **Result**: 16/16 regions HTTP 200, 48,423 rows pulled, `country` filter applied on the second pass
- **Source**: TradingView scanner (columns) · **Query / URL**: `name,description,close,open,high,low,volume,change,change_abs,market_cap_basic,exchange,currency,sector,price_earnings_ttm,dividends_yield,country,type` · **Status**: `ok` · **Result**: all 17 columns returned values for every row
- **Source**: Yahoo Finance HTML (verification only) · **Query / URL**: `finance.yahoo.com/quote/{7203.T,SAP.DE,RY.TO,2330.TW}/` · **Status**: `ok`
- **Result**: 4/4 quotes matched the CSV to the cent (Toyota 3,051 / 3,102; SAP €211.20 / €213.15; RY C$286.41 / C$285.46; TSMC NT$2,425 / NT$2,400)
- **Source**: shibui MCP bridge (verification only) · **Query / URL**: `shibui.stock_data_query` on RY, BHP, SAP, SHOP · **Status**: `ok`
- **Result**: prior-session closes matched the implied prior close of the source within ~1% (EUR/USD, AUD/USD, CAD/USD applied)
- **Source**: open.er-api · **Query / URL**: `https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD` · **Status**: `ok` · **Result**: 2026-10-28 rate table, 6 currencies
- **Source**: Frankfurter · **Query / URL**: `https://api.frankfurter.app/latest?from=USD` · **Status**: `ok` · **Result**: cross-check, agrees with open.er-api within 0.10% on EUR/AUD/CAD/JPY/DKK; no TWD
- **Source**: Yahoo Finance JSON API · **Query / URL**: chart / spark / screener · **Status**: `429 rate-limited`
- **Result**: not used — the scanner supplies every schema field, so no Yahoo enrichment call was made
- **Source**: `mcp__tradingview__*`, `mcp__yahoo_finance__*` · **Query / URL**: — · **Status**: `unavailable` · **Result**: not registered in this runtime (as documented in the cron prompt); the public scanner API replaced them
